==Biography==
Tomás Díaz Valiente is from Santiago, Chile.

=== 2017 Season===
His debut was in [[Furious Gaming Red|FG Red]] as a Mid Laner, participating in three tournaments:  [[Go4LoL/LAS/2017/June/Qualifier 2|Go4LoL LAS 2017 June Qualifiers #2]], where the team finished fifth in the tournament, losing against [[Zoltak Legion]] by 1-0, [[Go4LoL/LAS/2017/June/Qualifier 3|Go4LoL LAS 2017 June Qualifiers #3]], reaching finals by beating [[Dark Horse]] by 1-0, and [[Go4LoL/LAS/2017/June/Qualifier 4|Go4LoL LAS 2017 June Qualifiers #4]], where the team finished fourth in the tournament, losing against [[Aldeanos En Pijamas|Aldeanos]] by 1-0. At the end of the tournament he left the team.

=== 2018 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joined [[Infamous Gaming]] as a Mid Laner participating in [[Circuito Nacional Chile/2018 Season/Opening Season|2018 CNC Opening Season]] where the team reached finals facing [[Evilvice Esports]] and losing 3-0. He left the team after the tournament.

In the second half of the year, he joined [[Furious Gaming]] as a Mid Laner participating in the [[CLS 2018 Closing]], where the team finished fourth place in the tournament and qualified to the next phase. They ended up finishing [[CLS 2018 Closing Playoffs]] in fourth place, losing against [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] by 3-0.

=== 2019 Season===
He remained in the team, but changed his role to Top Laner, participating in the [[LLA 2019 Opening]] and finishing seventh place in the tournament. Still in the team, he played in the [[LLA 2019 Closing]] and finished third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. In the [[LLA 2019 Closing Playoffs]], they finished fifth place, losing against [[XTEN Esports]] by 3-2. At the end of the tournament he left the team.

At the end of the year he joined the Brazilian team [[Prodigy Esports]] as Mid Laner, participating in [[Superliga ABCDE 2019]], reaching finals against [[paiN Gaming]] but losing by 3-2.

== Trivia ==
* He was the first Latin American player to reach Rank 1 in Brazilian SoloQ.
* On March 11, 2026, he married [[Careta]].
